CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.b2b_payment_condition_config_list()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'auth_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  v_org := platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
  IF v_org IS NULL OR public.is_platform_superadmin(v_uid) IS NOT FALSE
     OR NOT (public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador'::public.app_role) IS TRUE OR public.has_role(v_uid,'financeiro'::public.app_role) IS TRUE
             OR public.has_role(v_uid,'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role) IS TRUE)
     OR public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b'::public.app_role) IS NOT FALSE OR public.has_role(v_uid,'parceiro_b2b_tecnico'::public.app_role) IS NOT FALSE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract','B2B_PAYMENT_CONDITION_V1','organization_id', v_org,
    'can_edit', public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador'::public.app_role) IS TRUE OR public.has_role(v_uid,'financeiro'::public.app_role) IS TRUE,
    'can_activate', public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador'::public.app_role) IS TRUE,
    'default_deadline_days', 30,
    'activation', COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(g) - 'updated_by' FROM platform_private.b2b_condition_activation g WHERE g.organization_id = v_org),
                           jsonb_build_object('mode','off','pilot_partner_ids','[]'::jsonb,'version',0)),
    'conditions', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('plan_id',v.plan_id,'method',v.method,'version',v.version,'deadline_days',v.deadline_days,
        'installment_count',v.installment_count,'monthly_rate',v.monthly_rate,'payment_method_id',v.payment_method_id,'category_id',v.category_id,
        'approved_at',v.approved_at,
        'retired',EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_condition_retirements r WHERE (r.organization_id,r.plan_id,r.version,r.method)=(v.organization_id,v.plan_id,v.version,v.method)),
        'partner_ids',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(a.partner_id ORDER BY a.partner_id) FROM platform_private.b2b_condition_assignments a
            WHERE (a.organization_id,a.plan_id,a.version,a.method)=(v.organization_id,v.plan_id,v.version,v.method)
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_private.b2b_condition_assignment_revocations x WHERE (x.organization_id,x.partner_id,x.plan_id,x.version,x.method)=(a.organization_id,a.partner_id,a.plan_id,a.version,a.method))),'[]'::jsonb))
        ORDER BY v.plan_id, v.method)
      FROM platform_private.b2b_condition_versions v
     WHERE v.organization_id = v_org AND platform_private.commercial_plan_admin_allowed(v.plan_id) AND v.version = (SELECT max(w.version) FROM platform_private.b2b_condition_versions w WHERE w.organization_id=v.organization_id AND w.plan_id=v.plan_id AND w.method=v.method)), '[]'::jsonb),
    'catalog', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', pm.id, 'name', pm.name) ORDER BY pm.name) FROM public.payment_methods pm WHERE pm.active IS TRUE), '[]'::jsonb),
    'categories', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', k.id, 'name', k.name) ORDER BY k.name) FROM public.financial_categories k WHERE k.active IS TRUE AND upper(btrim(k.type))='RECEITA'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'plans', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', p.name, 'code', p.code, 'max_days', p.max_days, 'monthly_interest_percent', p.monthly_interest_percent) ORDER BY p.name)
               FROM public.commercial_payment_plans p WHERE p.organization_id = v_org AND p.active IS TRUE AND p.superseded_by_id IS NULL), '[]'::jsonb),
    'partners', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(a.id ORDER BY a.id) FROM public.partner_accounts a WHERE a.commercial_owner_organization_id = v_org AND a.ativo IS TRUE), '[]'::jsonb));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_credit_exposure(p_partner_id uuid, p_new_order_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_exclude_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit numeric(14,2); v_open numeric(14,2); v_overdue numeric(14,2);
  v_committed numeric(14,2); v_pending numeric(14,2);
  v_new numeric(14,2) := ROUND(COALESCE(p_new_order_amount,0),2);
  v_proj numeric(14,2); v_disp numeric(14,2); v_pct numeric;
  v_tolerance int; v_block boolean; v_action text; v_reason text;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(credit_limit,0), COALESCE(overdue_tolerance_days,0),
         COALESCE(block_if_overdue,false), COALESCE(credit_limit_action,'block')
    INTO v_limit, v_tolerance, v_block, v_action
  FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id;
  v_limit := COALESCE(v_limit,0); v_tolerance := COALESCE(v_tolerance,0);
  v_block := COALESCE(v_block,false); v_action := COALESCE(v_action,'block');

  -- (a) recebiveis em aberto do parceiro
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_open
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE');

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_overdue
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    AND ari.due_date < (current_date - v_tolerance);

  -- (b) pedidos com compromisso financeiro real e SEM recebivel gerado
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_committed
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega',
                      'confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  -- (c) H4-001: pedidos vivos ainda nao aprovados ja consomem limite.
  --     Sem isso, N pedidos em analise passavam individualmente no teste
  --     de credito e estouravam o limite ao serem aprovados.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_pending
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('pendente','solicitado','em_analise_comercial',
                      'aguardando_aprovacao_credito','aguardando_ajuste_comercial',
                      'aguardando_itens')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  v_proj := ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending + v_new, 2);
  v_disp := GREATEST(v_limit - v_proj, 0);
  v_pct  := CASE WHEN v_limit > 0 THEN ROUND((v_proj / v_limit) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END;

  v_reason := CASE
    WHEN v_block AND v_overdue > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE_BLOCK'
    WHEN v_limit <= 0 THEN 'NO_LIMIT_DEFINED'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit AND v_action = 'approval_required' THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_APPROVAL'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BLOCK'
    ELSE 'OK' END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'partner_id', p_partner_id,
    'credit_limit', v_limit,
    'saldo_em_aberto', v_open,
    'saldo_vencido', v_overdue,
    'comprometido_nao_faturado', v_committed,
    'comprometido_pendente', v_pending,
    'novo_pedido', v_new,
    'exposicao_atual', ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending, 2),
    'exposicao_projetada', v_proj,
    'credito_disponivel', v_disp,
    'percentual_utilizado', v_pct,
    'overdue_tolerance_days', v_tolerance,
    'block_if_overdue', v_block,
    'credit_limit_action', v_action,
    'tem_vencidos', v_overdue > 0,
    'reason_code', v_reason
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_partner_order_payment_condition_secure(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE s platform_private.b2b_order_condition_snapshots; q platform_private.b2b_order_condition_quote_snapshots; v_present boolean;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.get_partner_order_payment_terms_secure(p_order_id);  -- mesmas portas do leitor de condição instalado
  SELECT * INTO s FROM platform_private.b2b_order_condition_snapshots x WHERE x.order_id = p_order_id;
  v_present := FOUND;
  SELECT * INTO q FROM platform_private.b2b_order_condition_quote_snapshots x WHERE x.order_id = p_order_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract','B2B_PAYMENT_CONDITION_V1','order_id', p_order_id,'present', v_present,
    'payment_condition', CASE WHEN v_present THEN jsonb_build_object('choice', s.choice, 'payment_method_name', s.payment_method_name,
      'installment_count', s.condition->'installment_count', 'monthly_rate', s.condition->'monthly_rate', 'deadline_days', s.condition->'deadline_days',
      'due_basis', s.due_basis, 'estimated', s.estimated, 'estimated_reference_date', COALESCE(q.estimated_reference_date,s.estimated_reference_date),
      'quote', s.quote AND q.order_id IS NULL, 'cart_hash', COALESCE(q.cart_hash,s.cart_hash),
      'schedule', COALESCE(q.rows,s.rows), 'principal', COALESCE(q.principal,s.principal),
      'financed_interest', COALESCE(q.financed_interest,s.financed_interest), 'financed_total', COALESCE(q.financed_total,s.financed_total)) END);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fiscal_invoice_apply_authorization_v1(_invoice_id uuid, _access_key text, _protocol text, _dh_recbto timestamp with time zone, _c_stat text, _x_motivo text, _transmission_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_inv public.fiscal_invoices%ROWTYPE; v_xml uuid;
BEGIN
  IF nullif(btrim(coalesce(_protocol,'')),'') IS NULL
     OR coalesce(_access_key,'') !~ '^[0-9]{44}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_AUTHORIZATION_PAYLOAD_INVALID';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_inv FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE id = _invoice_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_INVOICE_NOT_FOUND'; END IF;
  IF coalesce(v_inv.environment,'HOMOLOGATION') = 'PRODUCTION' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_PRODUCTION_ENDPOINT_BLOCKED';
  END IF;

  -- Idempotente: documento ja autorizado nunca e reescrito.
  IF v_inv.normalized_status = 'AUTHORIZED' THEN
    IF coalesce(v_inv.access_key,'') <> _access_key THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'FISCAL_AUTHORIZATION_CONFLICT: documento ja autorizado com outra chave.';
    END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('invoiceId', v_inv.id, 'applied', false,
      'normalizedStatus', v_inv.normalized_status,
      'reconciliationStatus', v_inv.reconciliation_status);
  END IF;

  -- Evidencia do XML assinado ja armazenado. O nfeProc (XML + protocolo) ainda
  -- nao e montado pelo transporte: enquanto nao existir, a nota fica PENDING.
  SELECT r.id INTO v_xml
    FROM public.fiscal_xml_runs r
   WHERE r.fiscal_invoice_id = _invoice_id
     AND r.signed_path IS NOT NULL
     AND (r.access_key IS NULL OR r.access_key = _access_key)
   ORDER BY coalesce(r.signed_at, r.updated_at) DESC LIMIT 1;

  UPDATE public.fiscal_invoices
     SET status = 'ISSUED',
         normalized_status = 'AUTHORIZED',
         access_key = _access_key,
         authorized_at = coalesce(_dh_recbto, now()),
         provider_status_raw = coalesce(_c_stat, provider_status_raw),
         tax_authority_notes = coalesce(_x_motivo, tax_authority_notes),
         -- xml_document_id NAO e sobrescrito aqui: o nfeProc protocolado ainda
         -- nao e gerado/armazenado pelo transporte (gate documentado).
         reconciliation_status = 'PENDING',
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = _invoice_id;

  INSERT INTO public.fiscal_audit_log (table_name, record_id, action, old_values, new_values, changed_by)
  VALUES ('fiscal_invoices', _invoice_id, 'UPDATE',
          jsonb_build_object('normalizedStatus', v_inv.normalized_status, 'status', v_inv.status),
          jsonb_build_object('normalizedStatus','AUTHORIZED','status','ISSUED',
                             'accessKey', _access_key, 'protocol', _protocol,
                             'transmissionId', _transmission_id,
                             'signedXmlRunId', v_xml,
                             'protocoledXmlStored', false), NULL);

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('invoiceId', _invoice_id, 'applied', true,
    'normalizedStatus','AUTHORIZED',
    'reconciliationStatus','PENDING',
    'signedXmlRunId', v_xml,
    'protocoledXmlStored', false);
END $function$
